title: pvGenerateQuadraturePoints
body:
## pvGenerateQuadraturePoints

Creates a point cloud (polydata with one vertex per quadrature point) from the selected quadrature offset array, carrying as point data the field-data arrays previously interpolated to the same offsets. The quadrature tools work in sequence: pvGenerateQuadratureSchemeDictionary adds a cell offset array QuadratureOffset carrying the quadrature rules, pvInterpolatetoQuadraturePoints evaluates point fields at the quadrature points, and pvGenerateQuadraturePoints turns them into a point cloud. Use it to view or export quadrature-point values, e.g. for finite-element verification.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Only field arrays linked to the selected offset array are carried; run pvInterpolatetoQuadraturePoints with the same offset array first.
- A missing dictionary yields an empty output with only a logged error.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `GenerateQuadraturePoints`. Identity: `filters/QuadraturePointsGenerator`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.
